diagram_math_checks.justification: Supplier ex-broken-trajectories-in-an-index-two-torus-moduli-space steps 2.1 and 3.1 give two independent u-arc and v-arc choices. Alpha_i:a to b and eta_i:c to d move u; beta_j:b to d and gamma_j:a to c move v. Both endpoint pairs are composable broken trajectories a to d.

Supplier steps 3.1 and 4.1 hold both arc choices fixed while relative delay tends to its two infinite ends, through b or c. Thus I_ij joins (alpha_i,beta_j) to (gamma_j,eta_i), for i,j in {1,2}. The four rows have eight distinct endpoints and no inter-row identifications; each row has one edge and two degree-one endpoints.

Carrier F3 and steps 2.1/3.1 give boundary sign = minus the product of comparison signs, with opposite signs at interval ends. Hence products s_ij and -s_ij are opposite. The diagram labels products explicitly and claims no fixed orientation or fixed value for s_ij. No arrow orientation or crossing is asserted.

Carrier step 1.2 assigns +1 to every trajectory, so all eight products become +1 and step 2.2 gives 8d. The existing rigorous counterexample and coherent-sign proof remain unaltered and independent of the figure.
